slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Koko rolled over in bed and the ceiling whirled. It stopped in under a minute, but what a fright.

One common cause is BPPV, where tiny crystals in the inner ear drift into a balance canal. Rolling over, lying down, sitting up or looking up can then set off a brief, intense spin.

Physios use specific positional tests to see which canal is involved, then gently guide your head through a sequence to move the crystals back. Many people notice a clear improvement within one to a few sessions.

Dizziness with a sudden severe headache, slurred speech, facial droop, weakness or trouble walking needs emergency care: call 000. Our Chatswood physios assess and treat positional dizziness. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
